transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

I... well, things at the company have been difficult. People are talking. I keep hearing them. The board members, mostly, or the staff. Saying I'm... ruining the company. 

I hear them right through the conference room walls. Or from my phone, even when it's completely turned off. It just... it sounds so clear to me. I actually catch myself answering them back before I realize... before I realize no one else heard it. So, I guess that's why I came in.
Around when did you first start hearing these voices?
I suppose... maybe about three months ago. That's when I first noticed it coming from the walls. And the phone.
Over these past three months, how has your overall mood been?
My mood? I don't... I'm not really sure. It's fine, I suppose. I haven't really been paying attention to that.
Have you had any physical health problems or medical conditions diagnosed recently?
Physical problems? No... nothing like that. My health is fine. I haven't been to a doctor for anything else.
During these past three months, have you experienced any periods where you felt persistently down, hopeless, or lost all interest in things you usually enjoy?
No... I don't think so. I just... I keep to myself and focus on my work. I haven't really felt hopeless or anything like that.
Have you been using any alcohol, recreational drugs, or non-prescribed substances recently?
No... I don't use anything like that. I don't really drink, either. Just... no.
